coreMechanic: choose water target while stationary; bait float waiting or click-retrieve lure; hook and alternate reel with release; catches swim in photographic generated aquarium
skill: water target and method selection, lure rhythm, hook timing, readable fish tension
score: total fishing score in one completed five-minute standard outing
failure: early/late hooks and excessive tension lose that fish; outing continues
practice: untimed independent outing; no local BEST, ranking candidate or production RUN
save: existing validated local-only standard:r1 score unchanged; aquarium shows current outing catches and is not persistent

inputs.keyboard: arrows aim; Space/Enter press-release cast, click retrieve lure, hook, hold reel; Escape pause
inputs.touch: tap/drag water target; bait/lure selector and phase-labelled single action; pointercancel cleanup

prototypeStatus: trial; technical QA distinct from author enjoyment
telemetry: existing lifecycle + specific_game_events sparse fishing observations; external OFF until actual Worker registration
rights: original gameplay, generated natural art with provenance; no third-party fishing game assets/code
